name: volume-card
title: Volume Card
description: A manga volume in a case: a 2:3 cover framed in ink with the volume number as a lettering tag on its corner, the title in lettering, the author, a status (new as a burst, ongoing as an ink flat, completed with a brush check, hiatus as an outline) and reading progress as a bar filled with speed lines with the count. Static by default; with href it is a link, with onSelect a button, both with the hover lift, the ink focus ring and a pressed offset. Works in a two-column grid at 360 px.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/volume-card". The cover is an image URL or any node (a 2:3 box is drawn for you); without a cover a screentone is shown.

meta.tagline: A manga volume with its cover, status and reading progress.
meta.usage:
import { VolumeCard } from "@/components/manga/volume-card"

<VolumeCard
  title="Night Rail"
  volume={2}
  cover="/covers/night-rail-2.jpg"
  author="M. Oda"
  status="ongoing"
  read={18}
  total={40}
  href="/volumes/2"
/>

props.name: volume
props.description: Shown as "Vol. 12" on the cover corner.

props.name: cover
props.description: An image URL, or any node drawn as the cover. Without it, a screentone.

props.name: author
props.description: Author or subtitle, under the title.

props.name: status
props.description: Status mark: burst, ink flat, brush check or outline.

props.name: total
props.description: Chapters in the volume. Shows the progress bar when set.
